tools.description: Tools is ordered by ToolCallCount descending.

original_tool_name.description:
OriginalToolName is the tool's raw backend-local name, empty when no
reversal was available (no reverser wired at capture time, a reverser
miss, or a row predating this field) — the client falls back to
ToolName in that case.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
